name: Motion Blur via Splat Smearing
definition: A technique to approximate motion blur in voxel buffers by smearing each sample along its motion vector. It distributes value evenly across touched voxels, preserving the sum of values.
summary: Motion Blur via Splat Smearing approximates motion blur by distributing sample values across voxels along a motion vector, offering efficient rasterization at the cost of lighting detail and camera motion cancellation.
